opener_concept: A level balance: two identical bags (each x kg) plus a 3 kg weight on the left balance an 11 kg weight on the right. Take 3 kg off both sides (11-3=8), then split the 8 kg between the two bags (8/2=4). That IS solving 2x+3=11 by doing the same to both sides then undoing each operation. Names the method as solving a linear equation.
